summary: Iteration 36 - Grommet Safety + Skeu UI + Peer Ratings. Ran 16 pytest cases (100% pass after 1 test-data fix). Frontend Playwright verified: AgeGate on fresh visitor, grommet lock icon on Creator toggle, Graduation modal (Get Guardian PIN -> PIN display -> wrong PIN 403 -> correct PIN graduation, mode flips to adult), grommet identity banner + Avatar3D 4 presets with persistence, Learn AI Grade card (S / 100/100 / Pitch+Timing shown, POST /api/gamer/grade fired), Studio skeu-panel + studio-pad-grid render, brand orange #FF5F1F everywhere after fixing one stray #FF6B00 in sonner.jsx. Adult regression smoke (Discover/Profile/Playlists/Backstage nav) all load without console errors.

ui_bugs.issue: POST /api/gamer/grade fires twice on lesson completion (likely StrictMode double-invoke inside functional state updater). Non-breaking but duplicates grade_history rows.

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify star-rating-{id} widget or Top Rated chip in-UI: /api/rap-battles/archive returns empty battles[]; the seeded rating for item_id 'battle_demo1' has no corresponding archived battle row, so ArchiveSection renders nothing (archive-empty). Backend rating flow itself passes (upsert/avg/count/my_stars/top all validated).

action_items: Seed an archived rap-battle row for 'battle_demo1' (or expose a dev seed endpoint) so the front-end StarRating + Top Rated chip flow can be verified end-to-end in the Battle Hub archive.

Investigate double POST to /api/gamer/grade on Learn lesson completion — the axios.post is inside a setMisses() functional updater, which will fire twice under React StrictMode. Move the API call out of the state updater (e.g., useEffect on `done`) so it fires exactly once.

GraduationModal reads userId from localStorage 'sidetrack_voter_id' with fallback 'anon'. If the id hasn't been generated yet on first render, all such users share the graduation state of the 'anon' account (observed as immediate 'already_graduated' on a fresh grommet). Ensure sidetrack_voter_id is initialized before AgeGate submit, or drop the 'anon' fallback in GraduationModal.
critical_code_review_comments: safety.py: peer_ratings upsert correctly indexed by (rater_id, item_id) — good.
safety.py: /safety/graduation/approve uses `attempts >= 5` before comparing code, so the 6th attempt with the correct PIN would still be blocked — desired per spec (must re-request PIN).

LearnPage.js:157-169: AI-grade axios.post is embedded inside a setMisses updater — under React 18 StrictMode dev, functional updaters run twice, causing double POST. Should be moved to a useEffect keyed on `done`.
GraduationModal.js:16: fallback 'anon' user id conflates unrelated fresh grommets; use a required prop or a guaranteed-initialized voter id.
sonner.jsx had one leftover '#FF6B00' (fixed inline) — consider replacing hardcoded brand hexes with a single CSS var (--brand-orange) to prevent future drift.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (all reachable flows pass; BattleHub star widget blocked by empty archive seed)

test_credentials: None — no auth. Fresh users need localStorage cleared to trigger AgeGate; setting sidetrack_voter_id before AgeGate ensures a unique user for graduation.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created ephemeral TEST_-prefixed users + peer_ratings rows. Non-destructive to existing seeded 'battle_demo1' rating.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_safety_grommet.py (16 tests, all pass). To re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_safety_grommet.py -v`. For Battle Hub star widget UI validation, seed an archived battle row matching item_id 'battle_demo1' first, then navigate Connect → Battle Hub → scroll to Archive section as an adult user.
rca of the issue: Star widget UI could not be verified because the seeded peer_rating references a battle_id that does not exist in the archive collection. Frontend behaves correctly (renders archive-empty state), but the intended end-to-end flow (rate → summary update → Top Rated chip) needs a matching archived battle document.
